summary: A semi-detached family home on a generous plot with ample off-street parking. Conservatory, living dining room, kitchen breakfast room and three bedrooms. A popular village location ideal, for both Carlisle and Penrith.
description:
A three-bedroom semi-detached house, with generous gardens in the rural idyll of Ivegill. The property offers an l-shaped conservatory which boast fantastic views of the garden. A kitchen breakfast room, fitted with oak finished shaker style units with contrasting worktops. A living dining room, with an open fire and stone surround. French doors lead out to a raise decking area, overlooking the garden. On the first floor, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms and a four-piece family bathroom.

The gardens wrap around the property, with a generous block paved drive and parking area. A lawned area to the front and side, with flower boarders, mature hedges, and tree. There is a utility garden area with two greenhouses and a garden shed.

The property would be a fantastic family home in the always popular hamlet of Ivegill. Located between Carlisle and Penrith. There is a primary school, with nursey, and a local public house the Crown Inn.

Buyers should be aware that local occupancy restrictions apply, for further information please contact our Carlisle office on Option 1.

Directions From our Carlisle office head south on the M6 motorway, leave the M6 at Junction 42. Taking the fourth exist signposted Dalston/Durdar. Turn left At the Durdar crossroads, following the road signs into Ivegill.

Services Mains electricity and water. Oil fired central heating. Drainage is to a shared septic tank, managed by Eden housing, the cost is shared between the properties the 2024 invoice was £72.19. Telephone line installed subject to BT regulations. Fibre Broadband available in the area. Please note - the mention of any appliances and/or services within these particulars does not imply that they are in full and efficient working order.
